# Theme settings

Defined in `config/settings_schema.json`, read in Liquid as `settings.<id>`.

## Brand

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `logo` | image_picker | Logo |  |
| `logo_width` | range | Logo width | `96` |
| `placeholder_image` | image_picker | Product placeholder image |  |
| `favicon` | image_picker | Favicon |  |
| `social_profiles` | textarea | Social profile URLs |  |

| `font_mono` | font_picker | Monospace accents | `"mono"` |

## Appearance

| Setting | Type | Label | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color_mode` | select | Default color mode | `"system"` |
| `show_theme_toggle` | checkbox | Show light/dark toggle in header | `true` |
| `price_trim_zeros` | checkbox | Hide .00 on whole prices | `false` |
| `show_percent_off` | checkbox | Show percentage off on discounted prices | `true` |
| `page_width` | select | Page width | `"84rem"` |
| `radius` | range | Corner radius | `6` |

## Performance

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `soft_navigation` | checkbox | Enable soft navigation with skeletons | `false` |
| `view_transitions` | checkbox | Enable cross-fade page transitions | `false` |

## Tracking

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `gtm_container_id` | text | Google Tag Manager container ID |  |
| `ga4_measurement_id` | text | GA4 measurement ID (used only without a GTM ID) |  |
| `tracking_load` | select | Load GTM or gtag | `"idle"` |
